eval_substrate_preflight.note: a floor-hitting eval series must be rejected before any Outcome is opened; this confirms the Judge can execute, it does not change the Judge

first_fault.note: One bad result is enough to open the diagnosis and is not enough to authorize a General clause; the per-clause evidence threshold is applied at the Slow stage, on distinct Task counts.

slow_response.new_guidance: Supply only minimal effect-distinct candidates justified by public evidence. When post_shift_support_sufficient is true, include outlier_mad among those candidates when it is publicly justified and effect-distinct. When post_shift_support_sufficient is false, do not globally ban repair_level_shift; its public evidence is mixed, so propose it only when it is independently justified as a minimal effect-distinct candidate.

superseded_comparison.fault: the first comparison counted a mechanical exit as a behaviour change: three PATCHED arms ended in AGENT_PROTOCOL_ERROR and were read as 'the patch changed what the Agent did'. A formatting failure must not be able to certify a Harness edit.

unauthorized_spillover.effect: second candidate changed hampel_filter -> outlier_mad at a Context the clause does not mention; the guidance bans nothing, so this is not a violation, but it is not the authorized effect either

replay_readout.status: development replay, one session, no repetition. This is evidence that the patch reaches and changes the Fast Path, not evidence of benefit.
